req.title: Deleting all tasks leaves empty table
req.statement: The system shall leave GET /tasks/ returning [] after every task has been deleted.
triggers: deleting all tasks leaves empty table

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-035 requires that after deleting every task, GET /tasks/ returns an empty list []. The test suite must: (1) positively verify that deleting all 20 pre-loaded tasks yields [] from GET /tasks/; (2) negatively verify that attempting to delete a non-existent task returns HTTP 404; (3) cover the boundary of deleting the last remaining task and confirming the transition to empty. Each test is self-contained, uses the in-process FastAPI TestClient, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
GET /tasks/ returns 20 items before any deletion
actions: GET /tasks/ to retrieve all task ids
expected: Final GET /tasks/ body length is exactly 0
trace: R-TASK-035: system shall leave GET /tasks/ returning [] after every task deleted
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list():
    r_before = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r_before.status_code == 200
    tasks = r_before.json()
    assert len(tasks) == 20

    for task in tasks:
        task_id = task["id"]
        r_del = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
        assert r_del.status_code == 204

    r_after = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r_after.status_code == 200
    body = r_after.json()
    assert body == []
    assert len(body) == 0

tests.name: test_delete_last_task_transitions_to_empty
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
All tasks except one will be deleted first
actions: DELETE all tasks except the last one in the list
Assert GET /tasks/ returns exactly 0 items and body is []
expected: After deleting 19 tasks, GET /tasks/ returns exactly 1 item
DELETE of the last task returns HTTP 204
After deleting the last task, GET /tasks/ returns HTTP 200 with body []
len of final response is exactly 0
trace: R-TASK-035: boundary — transition from 1 task to 0 tasks is the critical edge
BVA: n=1 (last task) boundary before empty state
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_last_task_transitions_to_empty():
    r_all = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r_all.status_code == 200
    tasks = r_all.json()
    assert len(tasks) == 20

    all_ids = [t["id"] for t in tasks]
    ids_to_delete_first = all_ids[:-1]
    last_id = all_ids[-1]

    for tid in ids_to_delete_first:
        r = client.delete(f"/tasks/{tid}")
        assert r.status_code == 204

    r_one = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r_one.status_code == 200
    remaining = r_one.json()
    assert len(remaining) == 1
    assert remaining[0]["id"] == last_id

    r_last_del = client.delete(f"/tasks/{last_id}")
    assert r_last_del.status_code == 204

    r_empty = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r_empty.status_code == 200
    final_body = r_empty.json()
    assert final_body == []
    assert len(final_body) == 0

tests.name: test_get_tasks_count_decrements_exactly_after_each_delete
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
actions: DELETE /tasks/1 — confirm count drops to exactly 19
DELETE /tasks/2 — confirm count drops to exactly 18
DELETE /tasks/3 — confirm count drops to exactly 17
expected: Deleted ids no longer appear in GET /tasks/ response
trace: R-TASK-035: each deletion must reduce the list by exactly 1
BVA + arithmetic-mutation: catches off-by-one in delete logic
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_tasks_count_decrements_exactly_after_each_delete():
    r0 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r0.status_code == 200
    assert len(r0.json()) == 20

    r_d1 = client.delete("/tasks/1")
    assert r_d1.status_code == 204
    r1 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    tasks1 = r1.json()
    assert len(tasks1) == 19
    assert all(t["id"] != 1 for t in tasks1)

    r_d2 = client.delete("/tasks/2")
    assert r_d2.status_code == 204
    r2 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    tasks2 = r2.json()
    assert len(tasks2) == 18
    assert all(t["id"] != 2 for t in tasks2)

    r_d3 = client.delete("/tasks/3")
    assert r_d3.status_code == 204
    r3 = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r3.status_code == 200
    tasks3 = r3.json()
    assert len(tasks3) == 17
    assert all(t["id"] != 3 for t in tasks3)
